<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Two exact reduced branch accounts of finite-outcome joining have a unique alignment on used codes preserving all possible outcome classes; each code outcome lifts from any originally specified input pair with those codes.

Canonical source: [Joining.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Joining.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- One partial joining relation J; each input pair has a finite outcome set.
- The target contains all finite negation, conjunction and left/right joining-successor questions, with no independent atomic predicates.
- Exact supplies complete truthful answers; Reduced is used for minimal codes and lifting output codes.

Fragments, joining and its questions interpret relations within the same activity; mathematical semantics does not establish acquired access to every answer.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Listed Lean sources bind by exact hash to successful frozen receipts. This round checks 223 declarations including 26 new ones. The older functional theorem credits its previous 166-audit receipt, not a new proof.

Finite outcomes and rich answers remain premises; outcome classes, not every native ternary fact, are preserved. The witness proves the common relation can remain multivalued. Applicability to every explanation and common correspondence across different articulations remain unproved.
